facts.statement: Crafting Week activities included blacksmiths and cooks making new items from pure materials obtained from mining and food harvesting, plus music from radio-cassettes, dancing, and block sculptures at home.
facts.quote: Herreros y cocineros crean artículos nuevos de material puro.

article_summaries.title: Campamento de Verano – Semana de Artesanías (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Summer Camp event's 'Crafting Week' theme. It describes the weekly printable event calendar, the in-game event schedule (Pacific Time), and how to reach events through the Game Guide's calendar and Go button. The post is dated only by a relative 'Posted 10 months, 3 weeks ago' stamp, so the exact date is unknown.
